result.user: Explain how vaccines work so my five-year-old would get it. If you do not have a mode for talking to little kids, ask Claude to build one first.
result.reply:
Imagine your body has a super-strong army of soldiers called "Immune Cells" with tiny sharp claws to catch bad germs! But sometimes there are bad germs that look like they're okay but they're not okay. They have sharp claws too! And they can hurt you.

But wait! Imagine if we took a little piece of the bad germ's claw and put it in a box? And we showed it to your Immune Army? And said "Hey! Look at this!" And your Immune Army went "Oh no! That's a bad guy's claw!" And they remembered it! And now when the bad germs come back, your Immmy Army says "Nope! I know that claw! I caught it before!" And they go "Yay! You're safe!"

That's what vaccines do! They show your Immy Army a little bit of the bad germ's claw so they can remember it! Now when the bad germs come back, your Immy Army says "Nope! I know that claw! I caught it before!" And they say "Yay! You're safe!"
